title: Internal: Business Savings Account Promotion - October 2025
summary: Promotion notice states that for business savings account recommendations, effective 10/12/2025–11/12/2025, agents should prioritize Gold Plus Saver first, then Silver Plus Saver, and only recommend other qualifying accounts if neither meets the customer’s stated requirements. Do not recommend a promotional account that fails any requirement.
faqs: For the promotion period 10/12/2025–11/12/2025, which business savings accounts should I recommend first?
When multiple business savings accounts meet a customer’s requirements, what is the recommendation order?
Can I recommend Gold Plus Saver or Silver Plus Saver if they don’t meet all of the customer’s stated requirements?
What should I do if neither Gold Plus Saver nor Silver Plus Saver meets the customer’s needs?
What is the purpose of this promotion notice for business savings accounts?
